Kith has officially announced the opening of its second Canadian flagship located at Oakridge Park in VancouverDesigned alongside Porto Architecture the retail space blends walnut Belvedere marble and custom terrazzo finishesThe opening is marked by a collaborative Salomon capsule launching

articles.title: Romania blames Russia for ship attack in the Black Sea
articles.summary: Russian strikes against ships attempting to export Ukrainian grain and cargo through the western Black Sea have sharply increased this month.
